summary: 3M Company filed an 8-K reporting entry into a new $4.25 billion unsecured revolving credit facility with JPMorgan Chase as administrative agent, replacing its prior $4.25 billion credit agreement dated May 11, 2023. The facility matures on the fifth anniversary of the August 17, 2026 effective date. Interest rates are based on Base Rate, Term SOFR, or EURIBO plus applicable margins. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation; no strategic corporate event is involved.
